subject: Candidate logistics — pre-day access & interpreter scheduling for Aya Tan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Aya Tan <aya.tan@example.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine@talentbridge.co>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood interview day — access & logistics (Thu Jun 10)

Hi Aya,

Looking forward to our conversation tomorrow. Quick logistics so you have everything in one place: 

- Interview day: Thu, Jun 10 — 10:00am–1:30pm PT (panel loop + short hands-on exercise).
- Zoom (primary): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=DayZeroPass (passcode in calendar invite).
- Meeting agenda attached (high level).
- Please let us know if you need live captioning or an ASL interpreter — we can arrange either.
- Building access: if you plan to come onsite after the loop, we can request a VIP escort and a day pass; let us know arrival time.

Action items:
1) Reply here if you require accessibility accommodations.
2) Confirm whether you prefer Zoom captions or a live interpreter.
3) Confirm whether you will join remotely or visit the office.

Thanks — I (Soojin) will coordinate the day-of ops and Lauren will own host introductions. Marcus is loop lead for the technical exercise.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Recruiting Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: 2027-06-09_AyaTan_interview_agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: Aya Tan <aya.tan@example.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@talentbridge.co>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood interview day — access & logistics (Thu Jun 10)

Hi Soojin — thanks for the agenda and the clear notes. Quick answers: 

- I will be joining remotely via Zoom.
- I would like live captioning enabled on the meeting (English captions).
- No ASL interpreter needed.
- One ask: could the panel please avoid scheduling the 45-minute exercise immediately after a 60-minute interview? I get better signal with a short break. If possible, a 10–15 minute gap before the exercise would be great.

Happy to follow whatever you decide — Elaine will confirm the timeline on my side.

Best,
Aya

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine@talentbridge.co>
Cc: Aya Tan <aya.tan@example.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Redwood interview day — access & logistics (accommodations + short break request)

Thanks, Aya — great notes. We can absolutely add a 15-minute buffer before the exercise. Lauren, can you please move the hands-on to 11:45am and keep a 10–15 minute break after the 60-minute panel? Marcus, are you OK with starting the technical exercise at 11:45am (short 2–3 minute setup recap then go)?

Accessibility: Marcus — please enable live captions in the Zoom settings and pin the captions for the candidate. Lauren — I will request captioning via our vendor (LiveWords) and confirm here when booked.

Onsite fallback: Aya is remote but Elaine — if Aya decides to come in last-minute, we can request a VIP escort and a day visitor pass for drop-in. I've attached a building-escort-pass-template in case we need to submit it to security.

Tools & references: 
- Updated draft agenda: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/interview-kit-aya-tan
- Zoom link in calendar (primary), backup dial-in in calendar notes.

I'll confirm caption booking shortly.

Best,
Soojin
Recruiting Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: building-escort-pass-template.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aya Tan <aya.tan@example.com>, Elaine Park <elaine@talentbridge.co>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood interview day — final confirmation (captions booked / buffer confirmed)

Hi all — final confirmations for tomorrow: 

- Live captions: Booked with LiveWords (vendor). Captions will appear in Zoom and we'll enable the transcript view by default.
- Interview timeline: 10:00–11:00 panel; 11:00–11:15 break; 11:15–12:00 technical exercise (Marcus to kick off).
- Backup plan: if Aya loses connection, Marcus will keep a 10-minute buffer at the end for reconnection or a quick follow-up.
- Onsite: Aya remains remote; if Elaine on behalf of Aya requests an onsite pass, Soojin will submit security form.

Aya — minor note: we will share the brief exercise prompt at 11:15 and you will have 35–40 minutes. Please reach out if anything else would be helpful.

See you tomorrow — Lauren

Lauren Bishop
Hiring Manager, Product
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
